gini_definition: G = sum_i sum_j |x_i - x_j| / (2 n^2 mu), x_i = monthly net_pnl per calendar month (zero-filled span), mu = mean(x) > 0 (all branches have positive total net; if mu <= 0 report null). Relative mean absolute difference; 0 = perfectly diffuse, ->1 = maximally concentrated.

method.cumulative_curve: cumulative net (sum of monthly net_pnl) curve over calendar months
method.gross_vs_costs: report gross_pnl, fees, funding, net_pnl sums from trades CSV alongside monthly stats
method.missing_file_policy: VERIFY each trades_csv exists before computing; skip missing branch with explicit note in summary.json (do not fail whole run)
method.month_key: calendar month YYYY-MM of exit_time in UTC
method.monthly_table: per calendar month: n_trades, n_wins, gross_pnl, fees, funding, net_pnl, cum_net
method.pnl_column: net_pnl summed per month (net of fees+funding as recorded in trades CSV)
method.span: calendar months from first-exit month to last-exit month inclusive, zero-filled for empty months
method.trade_concentration: top1_trade_share = max(net_pnl)/total_net; top5_trades_share = sum(5 largest net_pnl)/total_net; worst5_drag = sum(5 smallest net_pnl)/total_net (context)

files: summary.json (monthly tables + concentration stats + verdicts + sha256)
